_README: EXAMPLE ONLY — NOT REAL FIXTURE DATA. The teams, competitions, dates and kickoff times below are invented placeholders and must never be used in a report. This file is never loaded by the application. To supply a real list, copy it to 'fixtures.json' in this directory (or point CMG_FIXTURES_FILE at your own file) and replace every entry with verified fixtures.

_fields.start: required — kickoff, ISO 8601 with an explicit offset or a 'Z' instant
_fields.end: optional — final whistle; defaults to start + 120 minutes
_fields.competition: required if no team names — e.g. 'Premier League'
_fields.kickoff: optional display label; defaults to a label formatted from 'start'
